title: Echo Pulse — five real builds shipped
summary: A copy-ready daily update package for the BuiltByEcho social loop: homepage command center, social handoff pack, JSON feed, Shield reply kit, and product hotlinks.

builds.name: Homepage command center
builds.shortUpdate: Added a fresh July 8 shipping board to the homepage so the community can see five new real builds in one place.
builds.socialPost: Echo Pulse update: we added a fresh command center to the BuiltByEcho homepage. Today’s five builds are now grouped in one public board, with proof links and a clean path for people to see what actually moved instead of hearing vague roadmap talk.

builds.name: Social manager handoff pack
builds.shortUpdate: Created a dedicated updates page with copy-ready posts, proof links, and social-safe framing.
builds.socialPost: We built a dedicated Echo Pulse handoff page for the social team. The page turns shipped work into copy-ready posts with proof links, safe language, and no fake roadmap claims. That means every update can point back to something real.

builds.name: Machine-readable Echo Pulse feed
builds.shortUpdate: Published today’s five builds as a JSON feed so agents and dashboards can reuse the update pack.
builds.socialPost: Echo Pulse is now more than a post format. Today’s update pack also ships as a machine-readable JSON feed, giving agents, dashboards, and future automation a clean source of truth for what shipped, where the proof lives, and how to talk about it.

builds.name: Echo Shield community reply kit
builds.shortUpdate: Added a Shield reply kit for Discord and X so scan results stay card-first, caveated, and easy to share.
builds.socialPost: Echo Shield got a community reply kit. The scanner page now includes safer templates for Discord and X: card first, score second, warnings in plain English, and a clear reminder that Echo reports signals instead of calling anything safe.

builds.name: Product follow-up hotlinks
builds.shortUpdate: Added product hotlinks so social posts can route people to Shield, the npm lane, the update pack, and current builds fast.
builds.socialPost: The Products page now has a social follow-up hotlinks section. When a post mentions Echo Shield, npm tooling, current builds, or the Echo Pulse pack, there is a clean destination to send people instead of leaving them hunting through the site.
